_comment: License (PAY_FIRST 先付后用) client-software product under the QUOTA billing model (按量额度): the buyer pays receivePayment.productPrice (>= 1) upfront, then buys quota packs — each licenseEditions row is a pack with quotaAmount (额度数量) + billingPeriod (有效期); packs stack on the remaining balance and prices do NOT need to be ascending (ascending is an EDITION-only rule). licenseDeductionEnabled is forced off for QUOTA server-side. Trial dimension is quota-based (trialCount / trialCountPeriod); there is no trialDays under PAY_FIRST. For the default EDITION model (版本分层) use product.license.payfirst.example.json instead.

baseInfo.summary: Pay-first desktop app sold as quota packs: buy the app once, then top up 20/100/500 credit packs as you go — credits stack.

introduce.functions: Batch image enhancement, style presets, local-first processing, and a credit meter wired to the PowerSoftware license quota.
introduce.targetUserGroup: Designers and content teams who pay for usage rather than a seat license.
introduce.usageScenarios: Occasional bulk enhancement jobs where a monthly subscription would be wasted.
introduce.painPoints: Subscriptions charge for idle months; one-off keys don't scale with usage.
